title: RECOMMENDED MONTHLY CARD AVAILABLE
lines: DETAILS: During the event, players can log in daily to receive Orundum * 200 and Emergency Sanity Booster (recovers 80 Sanity) * 1. A total of 30 claims are available.
- The daily reward resets at 04:00 (UTC-7) every day.
- Unclaimed rewards will reset at 04:00 (UTC-7) each day and cannot be accumulated.
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Booster from this event.
02 TO LOOK BACK ON TERRA LIMITED LOGIN EVENT

DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 3 days to receive abundant rewards, including: Special Event Transfer Permit * 1 (Upon use, you may select one 6★ Operator from Saileach, Surtr, Pozëmka, Mudrock, Reed the Flame Shadow, Suzuran, Passenger, and Mizuki), Interactable Furniture - 'Echoes of Recollection', and Home Screen UI - Reconstruction.
Please stay tuned for more information!
